packageRules.description: Automerge patch updates once CI passes
Automerge minor updates for stable (>=1.0.0) deps after a 3-day soak
Do not automerge 0.x minors (breaking by convention)

Hold Kotlin at versions supported by koin-compiler (Kotlin 2.4.20 crashes koin-compiler with NoSuchMethodError: IrUtilsKt.getValueArgument; verified ceiling is 2.4.0). Lift once koin-compiler supports newer Kotlin.
Hold all org.jetbrains.kotlin artifacts for the same reason (koin-compiler ceiling). Lift once koin-compiler supports newer Kotlin.
